messages:
ben-sales: Heads-up 1: Prospect (Nimbus Finance) wants a BYO-KMS POC. Key asks: automated rotation demo, 7-day pen-test window, and a performance run showing 8k QPS w/ 99th pctile latency <120ms. Can we scope?
jules-se: Sounds doable. Need clarification on "automated rotation demo" 1: do they mean our rotation API orchestrating a KEK rollover in their HSM, or just manual instructions?
lee-crypto: We can do a live API-driven rotation only if customer keys are generated and remain in their HSM. Flow: customer generates KEK -> exports wrapped test keys -> we call rotation endpoint to accept new wrapped KEK thumbprint. We'll need a nonce handshake and signed thumbprints.
rachel-legal: Legal flags: include explicit warranty that Redwood will not request or hold plaintext KEKs, and specify audit log retention for rotation events (min 1 year). Also need pen-test liability cap language and an ops-sla carveout for test windows.
pat-eng-ops: For perf, we'll run a staged traffic profile. Earliest slot: Tue 02:0004:00 UTC. We can hit 8k QPS sustained for 10 mins with warm caches. We'll emit p50/p95/p99 and CPU per-token. Need their staging allowlist for our proxy IPs.
ben-sales: They pushed back: prefer Fri night window and insist on using their staging KEK to validate end-to-end. Also asked if BYO-HSM has a per-hour connector fee instead of a one-time onboarding fee.
jules-se: Connector fee model is possible. Proposal: onboarding waived for enterprise deals, connector runtime: $100/hour during POC + 0.75¢/HSM-request beyond baseline. I'll confirm final numbers with finance.
lee-crypto: Security: require HSM attestation (prefer FIPS 140-3 if available, otherwise FIPS 140-2 L3 acceptable). Add "no unencrypted key export" and verify key thumbprint (SHA-256) on import. Rotation window: we support 10-minute cutover with a 30-minute grace period for fallback.
rachel-legal: Also add a rollback playbook in the SOW: immediate rollback trigger, notification window (15 mins), and an execution runbook owner. Cap on test-induced outages: cap liability to single-month SLA credit or $25k, whichever is lower.
pat-eng-ops: Network: ask Nimbus to open outbound to our proxy pool: 52.23.101.5/32 and 52.23.101.6/32 port 443. Quick curl to validate TLS and thumbprint endpoint:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/thumbprint
```
We also need a signed PEM for their HSM admin to verify.
ben-sales: Next steps: 1) I'll propose Fri 02:0005:00 UTC and ask for allowlist + test-key deliverable, 2) Jules will get provisional pricing, 3) Lee to draft rotation handshake spec, 4) Rachel to draft liability and audit clauses, 5) Pat to reserve perf slot.
infra-bot: task-created: byo-kms-poc-1745054321 (owner=pat-eng-ops) due=1745140721
pat-eng-ops: Reserved Fri slot tentatively. If Nimbus confirms the allowlist and provides a wrapped-key bundle (test only) before EOD Wed we can run a preflight smoke test and keep Friday for the full run.
lee-crypto: I'll produce a minimal spec: wrap-alg (RSA-OAEP-256), thumbprint method (sha256 hex), signed nonce exchange, and required audit fields (actor, timestamp, action, key-id).
rachel-legal: I'll draft SOW snippets for: no plaintext key possession, rotation rollback playbook, pen-test indemnity cap, and required attestations. Sharing later today.
ben-sales: Great. I'll compile the SOW + demo plan + pricing and share with Nimbus. :rocket:
